name: Swing to switch · v1
notes: decent the only real issue is that if you use your left hand and swipe from left to right - assume watch is on left hand but make a note we may want to allow customization later. the travel back to start right to left may be confused with a full swipe it seems as though the relative travel space is what's critical swipe left means a short travel left to activate swipe and a longer travel to right is granted to allow back to reset before next command is issued in my opinon v2 solves most of this except tilt
